title: Power Amplifier
text: Model power amplifier with memory, {Model} sets Model type Memory; {Coefficient Matrix}, {Measured interval of PA data (s)} sets the sample interval of input-output, {Rin (ohm)} sets the input resistance, {Rout (ohm)} sets the output resistance and {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Model
params.values: Model type Memory polynomial (default) | Generalized Hammerstein | Cross-Term Memory | Cross-Term Hammerstein

params.name: Coefficient Matrix
params.values: Coefficient matrix 1 (default) | complex matrix | real matrix

params.name: Measured interval of PA data (s)
params.values: Sample interval of input-output data 1e-6 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
